methodology.cutoff_note: Conservative start-of-day cutoff; sample schedule kickoff is TBD. Market linkage must be independently verified.
methodology.epa: Equal-weight mean of source-published per-game EPA/play values, already rounded to two decimals. These are candidate research ranks, not the approved NFL exact metric.
nfl_parity_blockers: No scramble flag: scrambles remain runs; NFL defines them as dropbacks.
Published game EPA is rounded; exact unrounded play aggregation not audited.
Upstream play inclusion/penalty and garbage-time handling not independently reproduced in this CSV audit.
methodology.support: Source team-box NET passing yardage and completion/attempt values; season ratios divide totals. Net passing yards/attempt is not asserted equivalent to the NFL passing-yard metric. Rushing positive-EPA success averages per-game fractions equally. Passing/rushing TD totals unavailable in audited tables. See independent-review.json for one upstream net-yardage/attempt discrepancy.
methodology.ranking: FBS teams only, higher/lower as existing NFL categories; competition ties using exact rational representations of published values. No minimum sample threshold.
methodology.fcs: Two sensitivity variants; no standalone FCS rankings or opponent season metrics. The inclusion variant includes FBS offensive and defensive performance against FCS opponents. This does not approve either product behavior.
methodology.schedule_context: Mean current opposing-unit metric per meeting, with FCS opponents omitted; includes head-to-head performances, matching existing NFL sack-context convention.
